highlights: One Boros wallet at a time, like the Boros app: view any wallet, and log in to trade it
Telegram alerts for each wallet: a warning before a leg liquidates, when a wallet starts paying interest, a week before a pair matures, and when a later maturity pays more
Log in waits for Boros to confirm, and an expired or rejected login says so
The liquidation price is the real one, however far away, and it reads Gate's margin table so it is right on a large account
A coin Gate stops pricing says so, instead of quietly dropping off the card
A setup checklist on first run, and only coins both venues support
The Spot loop shows its time at the confirm step, and Boros reads cost less
